title: 용 세트 솔로 #017 · 한국·깃털 뱀(눈동자 최대)·혀 코랄 핑크·상아색 독니 기본 · P15 · 배경 스튜디오 짙은 남색 · 기반 `la_facesculpt_124`
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the middle of her chest, her whole shoulders, collarbones and chest in view, the frame cutting off below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A striking adult Korean woman — Korean elegant beauty with fair skin with a cool-neutral undertone and real visible pores, mid 20s, long straight espresso-brown hair with a centre part behind both ears, a full makeup: a flawless matte base, long lashes, sculpted cheeks and a soft glossy nude lip, real feathered serpent eyes: enormous glossy bright turquoise irises about twice the size of a natural iris, each iris filling the whole eye opening edge to edge from corner to corner and from upper lid to lower lid so that the eyes read as one large field of colour, with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, fine golden rays radiating from the pupil, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a fierce, intense stare — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face is natural and beautiful: a soft round face with full cheeks, a straight nose and naturally full lips. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a feathered serpent in emerald green, turquoise and gold with black-edged feathers and scales, red hibiscus flowers and sun rays around it, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes and eyelids stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in emerald green, turquoise and gold, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-emerald that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Feather crest: from the hairline above each temple a crest of long, flowing iridescent feathers in emerald green, turquoise and gold rises and sweeps backward along her head like the plumes of a quetzal, each feather about as long as her hand with a fine shimmering vane, the base of each crest growing out of her real skin, and the two crests are the same, framing her face on either side of her head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, real wet catchlights in the eyes and individual hair strands catching the light. Her skin is matte and natural, her forehead, nose and cheeks showing visible pores, fine skin texture and peach-fuzz with a soft, matte, dry-looking natural sheen, and the real skin around her brows, lips and the edges of her scales shows the same pores and texture. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while her eyeshadow is the animal-scale makeup described above): extremely heavy-lidded, almost closed, smouldering eyes with a very deep-set heavy upper lid covering about half of the iris,extremely thick long curled lashes resting on the lid and a long sharp winged liner; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her brows are bands of tiny overlapping iridescent emerald-green feathers with turquoise tips that follow the line of the brow from its inner end to its outer end, each feather visible, so that each brow reads as a feathered brow in the shape of a natural brow, sitting on the brow bone below the forehead tattoo, with the real skin of her forehead and eyelids around it and the pores visible. Her cheeks: from each cheekbone a short fan of small turquoise and gold feathers sweeps back toward her ear, the jawline and chin staying bare real skin. Her lips and mouth: her lips are a feathered serpent's lips, a row of small, smooth, glossy iridescent emerald-green scales with fine gold edges covering the whole of both the upper lip and the lower lip from one corner of her mouth to the other and following the outline of each lip, so that her upper lip and her lower lip both read as scaled lips, and from each corner of her mouth a fine gold line sweeps up and back in a gentle curve across the cheek, about as long as a thumb, like a long mouth line (this replaces any lip colour described above). Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, hot coral pink, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, ivory-white with a glossy wet sheen, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the thin tongue (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression). Below her neck: everything from the base of her neck downward is a feathered serpent's skin instead of human skin, so that her whole body below the neck is covered like a real feathered serpent's body: both shoulders, both collarbones, the hollow between them, the centre of her chest and the whole upper chest, from one shoulder to the other and from the neck down to the bottom edge of the frame, are covered edge to edge in one continuous, unbroken layer of overlapping iridescent feathers in emerald green with turquoise and gold tips, like the plumage of a quetzal, with small emerald scales showing between them near the base of the neck, every feather's vane and tip clearly visible, running right across the middle of her chest in the same size and pattern as on the shoulders, each one clearly visible; the covered skin begins at a clean line around the base of her neck, while her face and neck stay real human skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible; her long thin tongue stands out clearly against it.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about fifteen in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; one small bar or ring through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit one thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these three iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly ten separate massive solid weights, each of a different shape: on the left ear a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links; on the right ear a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links. On each ear the three iron rings share the weights between them in uneven numbers, each ring carrying its own column of weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is an enormous, dense, completely solid, squat, blunt lump of rough black cast iron, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between three openings, the weight pulls each earlobe down only very slightly into a soft, healthy loop of skin, a barely noticeable natural droop that is just enough to show the weights are heavy; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep midnight-navy backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
